title: Dotted Glow Background
description: Canvas dot grid where drifting glows brighten dots and tint them toward the brand.

a11y.motion: No animation runs: one still frame with the glows at fixed positions is drawn, and redrawn on resize and theme change.
a11y.keyboard: Not focusable. The glows stop while focus is inside the parent element (and while it is hovered, unless pauseOnHover is false); they also stop offscreen and in hidden tabs.
a11y.screenReader: Decorative; the wrapper and canvas are aria-hidden, so only the content layered above is announced.

examples.title: Pricing card
examples.description: A pricing card with a finer, dimmer grid and two glows behind the plan details.
